sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthMon = '3'
SELECT T1.birthYear FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.birthCountry FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 1933 AND T2.award = 'Second Team All-Star'
SELECT T2.birthCountry, T2.birthState, T2.birthCity FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.year = 1998 AND T1.notes = 'co-coach with Dave Lewis'
SELECT T1.shootCatch FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2010 ORDER BY CAST(T2.SHO AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2002 AND CAST(T2.GA AS INTEGER) > 150 ORDER BY CAST(T1.birthYear AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T1.birthMon AS INTEGER) DESC, CAST(T1.birthDay AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'NJD' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(T2.SA AS INTEGER) - CAST(T2.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH s AS (SELECT T.name, SUM(CAST(G.PostENG AS INTEGER)) AS e FROM Goalies AS G INNER JOIN Teams AS T ON G.tmID = T.tmID AND G.year = T.year WHERE G.year = 2010 GROUP BY T.tmID) SELECT name FROM s WHERE e = (SELECT MAX(e) FROM s)
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND year = 1922
SELECT G FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'dyeba01' AND year = 1921
SELECT DISTINCT pos FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'hartgi01'
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT PPG FROM Teams ORDER BY L DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL = '2011'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID, T2.award FROM AwardsCoaches AS T2 WHERE T2.coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.nameGiven FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005 AND T2.PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250 ORDER BY T2.GP DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.pos, T2.award, T1.nameGiven, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.pos = (SELECT M.pos FROM Master AS M INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS A ON M.playerID = A.playerID GROUP BY M.pos ORDER BY COUNT(A.award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T2.year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) OVER (), T1.name, T3.name FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.oppID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.year = 1915 AND T1.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T2.rank, T2.year, T2.name FROM Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE CAST(T1.SHA AS INTEGER) >= 7 ORDER BY T1.A DESC LIMIT 1
